name: [PILLAR CHASE UPD] HUNTED
desc:
[NEW CHAPTER] Pillar Pursuit is here! 

🙈 Welcome to HUNTED
The official Roblox version of the popular indie horror game franchise, Dark Deception!
Step into a cursed maze of terror where danger lurks around every corner. Can you collect all the soul shards while being hunted by relentless nightmares? Or will you fall victim to the horrors that await?

🚩 RECOMMENDATIONS & WARNINGS
Max graphics recommended.
Headphone and sound on recommended.
The game contains flashing lights and loud noises.

✅ PC, Mobile & Console Compatible
